iv-semantics: IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED in chainSupport means verified in at least one explicitly identified profile in that chain's profiles list, not repo-wide verification. The entries array covers only the 4 chains (btc, eth, trx, ton); the 9 additional chains (sol, bsc, matic, arb, op, base, avax, ltc, doge) are scoped to the multichain-extended-wallet profile. In entries, send/sign/broadcast/confirm mean the end-to-end flow including broadcast, which is not implemented anywhere; plan-transfer and local-sign in chainSupport are the implemented offline steps (transaction construction and local signing without broadcast).

entries.name: Bitcoin mainnet
entries.notes: Mainnet is the default (ADR-0003); verification covers network-independent repo tools for 24-word BIP-39 generation with an empty passphrase and watch-only derivation at the fixed path m/84'/0'/0'/0/i, not live-network flows. M-38 requires 6 confirmations as policy only, without enforcement code; transaction construction and local signing are implemented in the web profile (offline, wallet-core AnySigner); local signing also exists as a test-only signer in tools/mainnet-signing (temporary unfunded credentials only); broadcast is not implemented anywhere; BTC/ETH/TRX share xpub version 0488b21e, so cross-chain xpub misuse is undetectable from serialisation alone. The CoinGecko price feed via apps/web/src/wallet/prices.ts covers all 13 chains and is IMPLEMENTED_AND_VERIFIED.
